description: This file is a shell script for a watchdog mechanism used within the 'beerocks' project. It monitors certain processes by their PIDs, logs slowdowns, and triggers error handlers if processes are found to be zombie or stuck. The script provides process management, health checks, and logging functionalities specific to the 'beerocks' environment.

methods.name: killall_program
methods.description: Terminates all instances of a specified program by its name, optionally with a specified signal.

methods.name: is_program_running
methods.description: Checks if a program with the given name is currently running.
